DXCC 实体是奖状单位（政治 / 地理划分），分区是地理带的编号，二者并不一一: A DXCC entity is an award unit (a political / geographical division), whereas a zone numbers a geographical band; the two do not correspond one to one.
ITU 分区常用于频率协调与官方文书，日常通联交换的通常是 CQ 分区。: ITU zones are used for frequency coordination and official documents; day-to-day contacts usually exchange the CQ zone.
WAZ 奖状要求通联全部 40 个 CQ 分区；用本图对照日志查看缺口。: The WAZ award requires working all 40 CQ zones; compare your log against this map to see what is missing.
{label} 分区计数之和应等于全部实体数: The {label} zone counts should add up to the total number of entities
中国大陆横跨 CQ 23 / 24 区与 ITU 33、42–44 区（西部含: Mainland China spans CQ zones 23 / 24 and ITU zones 33 and 42–44 (zone 33 covers the far west); Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan each have their own zones.
全世界划分为 40 个 CQ 分区，是 WAZ（通联全部 CQ 分区）奖状与竞赛: The world is divided into 40 CQ zones, the basis of the WAZ (Worked All Zones) award and of contest exchanges.
全世界划分为 90 个 ITU 分区，源自国际电信联盟的频率与呼号管理划分。: The world is divided into 90 ITU zones, derived from the International Telecommunication Union's division of frequencies and callsigns.
本图按每个 DXCC 实体的主分区着色；俄罗斯、美国、中国等横跨多个分区的大国会: This map is shaded by each DXCC entity's principal zone; large countries spanning several zones, such as Russia, the United States and China, are assigned to one zone as a whole.
竞赛中常需交换 CQ 分区号，可在「呼号查询」页输入呼号直接读出。: Contests often require exchanging the CQ zone number; you can read it directly by entering a callsign on the "Callsign lookup" page.
跨分区的大国以主分区编号为准，边境操作时以执照与本地约定为准。: For large countries spanning several zones the principal zone number applies; when operating near a border, follow your licence and local practice.
